title: Horological vocabulary, Part 1: Technical and scientific definitions
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12745 (PART 1)) covers Horological vocabulary, Part 1: Technical and scientific definitions. This Indian Standard (Parti) which is identical with ISO 6426/1 : 1982 'Horological vocabulary — Part 1 : Technical and scientific definitions', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO) was adopted by the on the recommendation of the Horological Sectional Committee ( EDC 82 ) and approval of the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards, attention is specially drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'international Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'; and b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use point ( . ) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
